question: 单项选择：I _____ this book yesterday. A. read  B. have read  C. am reading  D. will read
answer: 答案：A. read。解析：yesterday是过去具体时间，用一般过去时。

question: 单项选择：I _____ this book. I know the story well. A. read  B. have read  C. am reading  D. will read
answer: 答案：B. have read。解析：I know the story well说明对现在的影响，用现在完成时。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：She ______ (go) to Shanghai last year.
answer: 答案：went。解析：last year是过去具体时间，用一般过去时。go的过去式是went。完整：She went to Shanghai last year.

question: 单项选择：She _____ to Shanghai three times. A. has been  B. went  C. has gone  D. goes
answer: 答案：A. has been。解析：three times强调经历，用现在完成时。have been to"去过"。

question: 翻译句子：我昨天去了公园。
answer: 答案：I went to the park yesterday. 解析：yesterday是过去具体时间，用一般过去时。go的过去式是went。

question: 单项选择：I have _____ been to the Great Wall. A. ever  B. never  C. already  D. just
answer: 答案：B. never。解析：never"从未"，强调过去的经历对现在的影响，用现在完成时。

question: 用所给词的适当形式填空：I ______ (just, finish) my homework.
answer: 答案：have just finished。解析：just"刚刚"是现在完成时标志。完整：I have just finished my homework.

question: 单项选择：— Did you see him yesterday? — _____. A. Yes, I do  B. No, I didn't  C. Yes, I have  D. No, I haven't
answer: 答案：B. No, I didn't。解析：Did you see...?是一般过去时一般疑问句，否定回答用No, I didn't。

question: 翻译句子：到目前为止我已经学了十个单元。
answer: 答案：So far I have learned ten units. 解析：so far"到目前为止"是现在完成时标志。

question: 单项选择：I _____ him since 2020. A. know  B. knew  C. have known  D. will know
answer: 答案：C. have known。解析：since 2020是现在完成时标志。
